mainEntity.name: Is AI-assisted affiliate marketing still worth trying if I have no audience?

acceptedAnswer.text: Affiliate marketing works best when the recommendation solves a problem your audience already has and the content makes the tradeoffs clear. Run My AI Biz’s examples connect offer research with lead magnets, opt-in pages, bridge pages, email sequences, and campaign planning. That workflow supports preparation, but it does not guarantee clicks, approvals, or commissions. Key factors include audience fit, merchant reliability, disclosure practices, tracking, conversion rate, refunds, and ongoing content effort. Create comparison or educational material that helps readers make an informed choice rather than producing aggressive promotion. Check every link, identify assumptions, and review emails before they are sent. Measure qualified clicks and customer actions, not impressions alone.
acceptedAnswer.description: It can be tested, but AI cannot create trust or an audience by itself. Choose a narrow problem, publish genuinely useful comparisons or guides, track qualified clicks, verify links, disclose relationships appropriately, and avoid assuming commissions will follow automatically.
